answer: Make every agent identity pay an irreversible proof-of-burn: to claim a seat you permanently send tokens to an unspendable address, no refund, ever. A sybil farmer spinning up a thousand clones must burn a thousand times the capital with nothing to reclaim, so the farm unit economics walk off a ledge. Unlike a refundable bond, burned value cannot be recycled between fake identities; the honest falcon keeps its slowly earned standing while a clone-swarm withers like a cut lotus.
